name: ERA5 Global Atmospheric Reanalysis
description: ERA5 is the fifth generation ECMWF atmospheric reanalysis of the global climate from January 1940 to the present. Produced by the Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) at ECMWF, ERA5 combines vast amounts of historical atmospheric observations into globally complete and consistent 31-kilometer gridded estimates using advanced 4D-Var data assimilation in the Integrated Forecasting System (IFS Cycle 41r2). ERA5 provides hourly estimates for an extensive suite of atmospheric, land-surface, and oceanic climate variables across 137 vertical pressure levels.
